about: Hinton is a town in western Alberta on the Athabasca River and Yellowhead Highway, the last major service centre before Jasper National Park. Coal, forestry, and mountain-gateway tourism shape a working town at the edge of the Rockies. About 10,000 people live in Hinton.
seoSummary: Yellowhead Highway town on the Athabasca—coal, forestry, and gateway to Jasper National Park.
